title: NextStat Public Benchmarks: Snapshot (Template)
description: Immutable benchmark snapshot for NextStat public benchmarks. Includes baseline_manifest.json, raw suite outputs, and a README snippet. Optionally may include snapshot_index.json (hash inventory plus suite-level health verdicts), snapshot_registry.json for collection-style releases, and nextstat_wheel.whl (self-contained exact build).
notes: Fill in snapshot id, harness commit SHA, and NextStat version in the description before publishing.
